notes.coordinates: Stage-space XYZ in game units. Use the map's stage list to resolve area indices.
notes.mesh_geometry: The draw command has no separate object origin. Placement is in the model's vertices.
notes.animated_anchor: Stored reference position. Runtime movement, rotation or scaling can change the rendered geometry.
notes.runtime_parameters: The command has no position data stored in the overlay file.
notes.stage_specific: Custom draw behavior. Mesh index is the stored command field and may not identify the final rendered geometry.
notes.grass_patches: Connected geometry using four visually identified standalone grass textures in Forest and Hills. Estimated bases are bounds-derived, and one tuft can span multiple patches. Mixed texture atlases, ground texture paint and quest gathering props are outside this pass.
notes.scope: Base stage draw data. Quest-specific props, collision shapes and runtime-only geometry are outside this export.
